text: I'm a childminder and I've got a 5 month old girl overnight as a favour. Her temperature is 38.5 and I'm scared because she's so little. She hasn't done a poo in three days and she's really grumpy about it, straining and moaning, pulling her legs up. I checked her all over and there's no rash at all. Her breathing looks normal, I've watched it for a good while. Mum is uncontactable till morning. Please tell me what I should do.
